subject: prd/impl-review
statement: If the host or worker dies mid-process, or the same process is invoked again, then the system shall resume idempotently from persisted process→pass→internal-round state, reap orphaned work, and never convert a retry or remediation round into another assurance pass
intent: one converged process, never duplicate passes or a husk
fit_criterion: kill points before/between/inside passes resume at the exact level; double invocation is a no-op; required pass count and context identities remain stable
